newsitem.title: CHINA: Heng Fung in HK$150 mln new shr placement.
newsitem.headline: Heng Fung in HK$150 mln new shr placement.

text.p: Heng Fung Holdings Co Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to place 166.70 million new shares at HK$0.90 with independent private investors for HK$150.03 million to develop and support its investment and lending business.
The placing shares represented about 20 percent of the existing issued share capital of the company and 16.67 percent of the enlarged issued share capital, the company said in a statement.
Shareholding of the company's chairman Chan Heng Fai and his wife would be diluted to 9.12 percent from 10.94 percent following the placement, it said.
Heng Fung shares gained HK$0.04 to HK$1.05 by late Tuesday morning.

The principal activities of the company and its subsidiaries are investment holding, property investment and development, management consultancy, securities investment, and sale of building material machinery and pharmaceutical products.
